scientific_integrity: The all-order proof is analytic and coefficientwise. The bundled finite exact checks are corroborative only. Source premises are independently restricted to the published boundary-law equations and their Gibbs-measure interpretation.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to ferromagnetic soft-core tree-automorphism-invariant splitting Gibbs measures for \(k\ge4\), \(0<\theta<1\), and \(\lambda>0\). No claim about extremality, non-translation-invariant splitting measures, all Gibbs measures, dynamics, or the antiferromagnetic regime. The hard-core endpoint is excluded from the novelty claim.
title: Exact all-order soft-core Widom–Rowlinson TISGM phase boundary
